title: The second assignment-update equality changes the wrong variable.
details: Junttila, Many-Sorted First-Order Logic, Semantics, immediately after term-evaluation examples: the assignment update for a sorted variable x is defined, but its equality for an unchanged variable y uses an update at the propositional-variable symbol instead of x. Repair: use the same updated interpretation I[x maps to v] in both equations; it maps x to v and preserves the value of every y different from x. This is a local subscript typo; the stated preceding definition and later quantified truth clauses identify the intended update.
